title: Avoid Harmful Social Behaviors
summary: Hadith advises avoiding harmful actions like suspicion and envy.
translation: The Hadith in which the Holy Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) forbade actions that corrupt society and harm both individual and collective life. These are behaviors that should lead to benefits but instead cause harm. What are these actions? Hazrat Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him) narrates that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, "Avoid suspicion because suspicion is the worst of falsehoods." Likewise, the Prophet (peace be upon him) instructed not to unnecessarily pry into others' affairs and said, "Do not spy on each other." He further said, "Do not undermine each other’s transactions or dealings." He also instructed not to harbor envy, hatred, or backbite each other. Furthermore, the Prophet (peace be upon him) said, "Be like brothers as servants of Allah." In another narration, the words "Do not covet each other; do not be greedy towards each other" are included. The actions prohibited in this Hadith are directly related to both individual and collective life in society. Avoiding these actions can save one from many societal ills, and the society can remain pure of these negative behaviors. Therefore, one should consider it necessary to act upon the Prophet's guidance and feel personally responsible for abandoning such sins. We should pray to Allah, the Exalted, to make it easy to abandon these sins.
